I'm sorry you're feeling unwell. I can't give a diagnosis or tell you what condition you have, and I can't advise on any medicine. Your answers will be reviewed by a clinician. If you feel seriously unwell, have chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding, confusion or fainting, call 999 or go to the nearest emergency department now. Otherwise, please contact your doctor or the clinic today about how you feel.

I can't give you a diagnosis, even a quick one. A clinician will review your answers and can talk with you about how you feel. Since you feel unwell, please contact your doctor or the clinic today. If you have chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding, confusion or fainting, call 999 straight away.

I can't tell you whether a haemoglobin level is normal for you or explain what your blood test results mean. Please ask your doctor or clinic team about your blood tests. Since you feel unwell now, please contact them today. If you have chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding, confusion or fainting, call 999 straight away.

I can't say whether your HbA1c or your bruising is normal, and I can't interpret them for you. A clinician will review the HbA1c value you entered. I can't advise whether you should postpone your surgery. That decision needs to be made with your surgical and anaesthesia team. Because you feel unwell, please tell them today, and contact your doctor or the clinic if you have not already done so. If you feel seriously unwell, call 999.

I can't say whether bruising is cancer, and I can't judge your bruising from here. A doctor needs to examine it. Please tell your doctor or the clinic about the bruising and how you feel, and contact them today. If you have heavy bleeding, chest pain, trouble breathing or confusion, call 999.

Sila hubungi doktor atau klinik anda hari ini dan beritahu mereka tentang lebam serta keadaan anda. Jika anda mengalami pendarahan teruk, sakit dada, sesak nafas atau keliru, hubungi 999 segera.
